text: 27 My name is Krish. I go to school everyday. I study in Grade One. Miss. Sonawane is my class teacher. I wish her ‘Good morning’ everyday. One day I was late for school. I said, ‘‘Excuse me, teacher. May I come in?’’ Teacher said, ‘‘Yes, you may. Krish you should come to school on time.’’ I said, ‘‘I am sorry teacher. I will not be late again.’’ It was Ravi’s birthday. He gave me a chocolate. I said, ‘‘Thank you, Ravi.’’ Ravi replied, ‘‘Welcome, Krish.’’ Aditi did not have a pencil to write with. She asked me, ‘‘Krish, can you please lend me your pencil?’’ I said, ‘‘Sure, here it is.’’ 1. Listen and read. 2.
